name: Marketing SMB v1
summary: Portable, draft-only CMS template export with a formal content contract, neutral copy, and local asset inventory for small-business marketing sites.

license.notes: Internal LiNKtrend reusable content. Cross-repository reuse is permitted for LiNKtrend systems; external redistribution requires Principal authorization.

securityReview.notes: Read-only source alignment found no credentials, secrets, customer data, external URLs, or live integration settings. Seed records remain draft-only and require siteId/locale/status scoping. Independent review remains required before formal production admission.

quarantine.reason: Experimental entry: LiNKsites renderer compatibility and Payload CMS compatibility are unknown and unverified. Independent certification is required before selection or production admission.

usage.howToUse: Import the portable src/index.mjs export, validate the strict content input, and render or adapt its complete draft site tree while preserving its ownership, scoping, and publication boundaries.
examples: Use the pageTemplates array to plan the CMS Pages records for a new SMB site.
Use the navigationTemplate and complete executable draft output after validating consumer input.

integrationNotes: This entry supplies its own portable component, layout, design-system, media, and draft-content implementation. LiNKsites renderer compatibility and Payload CMS compatibility are unknown and unverified; independent certification is required before selection or production admission. A consumer may adapt the returned tree, but must not install it automatically, create a customer site, select an endpoint, or publish content from the Library consumer.
gotchas: Keep every CMS read and seed record scoped by siteId and locale, with status explicitly controlled.
The executable draft output is draft-only and uses substitution markers; validate business copy, links, and required records before preview or publication.
Do not treat the Library entry as proof that a live site, webhook, analytics property, domain, or deployment exists.
LiNKsites renderer and Payload CMS compatibility remain unknown and unverified; independent certification is required before selection or production admission.
Consumers must not silently extend the validated component or content contract; any new capability requires a new Library artifact revision.
